children: Richard J. Rothberg, an officer serving as General Counsel & Secretary, sold 4,000 shares of Class C Common Stock at $583.364 per share for total proceeds of $2,333,456 and, following the transaction, directly owned 132,415 Class C Common Stock shares.

Kennedy David Alan, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, sold Class C Common Stock on 2026-09-17 at weighted average prices of $584.9769 and $586.0321 per share for total proceeds of $13,979,586 and, following the reported transactions, directly owned 159,201 Class C Common Stock shares.
